You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 263bd0802cb405f1025b83dbce468481b6516cd3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Paul Cercueil <paul.cercueil@analog.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Apr 2017 11:37:45 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] Fix broken iio_device_get_sample_size with same-index
 channels

This fixes a bug introduced in 4792fa3.

Signed-off-by: Paul Cercueil <paul.cercueil@analog.com>
---
 device.c | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/device.c b/device.c
index a1410746..8ce3c924 100644
--- a/device.c
+++ b/device.c
@@ -451,6 +451,8 @@ ssize_t iio_device_get_sample_size_mask(const struct iio_device *dev,
 			size += 2 * length - (size % length);
 		else
 			size += length;
+
+		prev = chn;
 	}
 	return size;
 }
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect handling of channels with the same index in the `iio_device_get_sample_size` function. The previous implementation did not properly account for the previous channel when calculating the sample size, leading to incorrect results when channels had identical indices. The patch adds a line to update the `prev` variable to the current channel (`chn`) at the end of the loop, ensuring that the logic correctly processes channels with the same index.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the incorrect handling of channels with the same index in the `iio_device_get_sample_size` function. The previous implementation did not properly account for the previous channel when calculating the sample size, leading to incorrect results when channels had identical indices. The patch adds a line to update the `prev` variable to the current channel (`chn`) at the end of the loop, ensuring that the logic correctly processes channels with the same index.
